tool_input.description: Add pin API hook, pin button, badge, mock handler, types and a test

result:
Pinning is implemented in `apps/react-vite`, but nothing has been run: no tests, lint, type check or app, as you asked.

- **Discussion page:** admins see a "Pin Discussion" / "Unpin Discussion" button next to "Update Discussion". A success notification shows after each change.
- **Discussions list:** pinned discussions come first, and a "Pinned" badge shows next to the title.
- **Mock API:** the discussion model has a new `pinned` boolean, and a new `PATCH /discussions/:discussionId/pin` handler (admin only) stores it. Discussions already saved in the mock DB load as not pinned.
- **Ordering:** the list handler sorts pinned discussions first before it paginates, so they are at the top of page 1, not at the top of each page.

I also added one test, "should pin and unpin discussion", to `src/app/routes/app/discussions/__tests__/discussion.test.tsx`.

The new files are `src/features/discussions/api/pin-discussion.ts` and `src/features/discussions/components/pin-discussion.tsx`. The other changes are in `discussion-view.tsx`, `discussions-list.tsx`, `src/types/api.ts`, `src/testing/mocks/db.ts` and `src/testing/mocks/handlers/discussions.ts`.
